adjacentHistoricalClean.role: Earlier same-image/source emission; not an interleaved clean baseline. Retained as context only, never inserted as a profiler row.

physicalProfile.weighting: rawFraction pools counts; periodWeightedFraction weights each sample by its capture period. Approximate CPU costs multiply period-weighted fractions by independent clean median CPU time.
limitations: A sample count threshold is not a confidence interval.
Repeated periods may alias; retain period-specific captures and compare them.
Unknown samples remain in denominators. Rejected captures remain visible but are excluded.
Fractions describe the captured interval. Absolute CPU estimates additionally require its process CPU to cover 95% of whole-child CPU; unavailable lifetime coverage preserves fractions only.
Physical leaf costs do not identify logical callers or ownership origins.
Diagnostic-runtime samples may distort the clean distribution even with an explicit baseline.

scope: Single actual final-N2 full compiler-source sampling run with exact pre-existing whole-QBE oracle. Physical leaf fractions and bounded libc caller recovery only; no paired clean baseline, runtime event counters, active dispatch contexts or new gain ratio.
limitations: One32ms sampling period can alias repeated work. Sample size does not eliminate systematic sampling bias.
Timeline ordinal×period is approximate sampled-thread CPU coordinate from sampling start, never wall time or an asserted phase boundary.
Lexical physical owners apply only to sampled code with authenticated symbol/FID mapping; runtime/callee cost is not attributed to source callers.
Earlier379.228s same-source emission is retained as historical context, not a new paired clean profiler observation.
